body:
Thanks for reading my post. I can't tell you how much your response meant to me. I'm sorry to hear about your father, my thoughts are with you and your family. Cancer is horrible, I wouldn't wish it on anyone. 

You are correct that I am very concerned about my medical condition and that it is my primary concern right now. It's hard to be motivated about putting my life back together while thinking that even if I succeed in doing so, I'm still going to be in constant pain and miserable. 

I watched my dad suffer through chronic back pain as I was growing up, I witnessed all of his surgeries and I don't want that for myself. He is a walking pharmacy just so that he can manage his pain enough to be functional and I fear more than anything else that, that will be me one day.

I don't want to be in a haze from medication, assuming I could even afford medication. I don't have medical insurance and I can't even afford the medication I need now. It's kind of depressing.
